ns2:course.label: Photography II
ns2:course.description: Explore fundamental facets of image-making with thematic focus on the notion of the Analogy, and intersections of analogue, digital, and virtual processes of visual communication. This includes work with 35mm and medium format analog film, darkroom printing, color film scanning, advanced inkjet printing, photo sculpture, and cyanotype processes. An integral aspect of this class will be exercising a critically engaged vocabulary to describe how photographs make meaning, and the development of a personal aesthetic. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTS 264. Restricted to Art majors only.
